goal: Generate developer documentation for a large repository using Recursive Language Model (RLM) decomposition.
use: Generate developer documentation for a large repository using Recursive Language Model (RLM) decomposition. Use when asked to document a codebase, write module or API reference pages, or explain how modules connect, when the code is too large to read in one pass.

steps.note: Inspect. Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py scan <repo>` for the size and layout.
Graph. Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py graph <repo>` to see how modules import each other.
Map. For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees only that chunk file and the "Chunk task" below.
Write. Create one document per top-level module or package, plus an overview page that uses the import graph.

protocol.title: Inspect
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py scan <repo>` for the size and layout. If the repo is very large, agree the scope with the user (for example, one package at a time) and narrow it with `--include 'pkg/*'` (repeatable) on every command. Files over 20 MB are skipped; report what `scan` lists as skipped.

protocol.title: Graph
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py graph <repo>` to see how modules import each other. Use it for the "how it connects" section.

protocol.title: Partition
protocol.text: Run `WORK=$(mktemp -d)`, then `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py chunk <repo> "$WORK/chunks"`. Chunks are limited to 800 lines and 100,000 characters each, and are cut between definitions where possible.

protocol.title: Map
protocol.text: For each chunk, run a fresh sub-task (a subagent if you can start one) that sees only that chunk file and the "Chunk task" below. It writes `"$WORK/out/<chunk>.out.md"`. If you cannot start sub-tasks, run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py pending "$WORK/chunks" "$WORK/out"` and process the first listed chunk: read it, write its output, then run `pending` again until nothing is pending.

protocol.title: Reduce
protocol.text: Run `python3 <skill>/scripts/rlm_corpus.py merge "$WORK/out" --out "$WORK/merged.json"`. Re-run any `failed_outputs`. Missing output means the module is undocumented, not that it is simple. Repeat the map step if the merged facts are still too large to work with.

protocol.title: Write
protocol.text: Create one document per top-level module or package, plus an overview page that uses the import graph. Use the format below.

protocol.title: Verify
protocol.text: Check every signature you quote against the source file. Remove anything you cannot confirm.

protocol.title: Clean up
protocol.text: Delete `$WORK` after the documents are written.
